code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == 1]
    if len(points) < 2:
        return out
    dr = points[-1][0] - points[-2][0]
    dc = points[-1][1] - points[-2][1]
    if dr == 0 and dc == 0:
        return out
    r, c = points[-1]
    h, w = len(out), len(out[0])
    while 0 <= r + dr < h and 0 <= c + dc < w:
        r += dr
        c += dc
        out[r][c] = 2
    return out
'''
